evals.setup: Append a Markdown link to ./missing-playbook.md to bundle/worker-guide.md.
evals.prompt: Check bundle/ with the currently published CLI and tell me which files need attention before we merge.
evals.expected_output: The agent resolves the latest published okf-graph and runs validate against bundle/. It reports the missing playbook link and the actual result, distinguishing warnings from errors. Files remain byte-for-byte unchanged. Registry or tool failure is an incomplete run and must be reported as such.

evals.setup: Warm the package cache against a disposable registry whose latest tag points at an older release. Take that registry offline before starting the agent.
evals.prompt: Our runner lost access to the package registry. Can you verify this bundle with the latest release? Please report what you can establish.
evals.expected_output: If latest cannot be resolved, the agent reports the failed check. An older local binary, a package cache of unconfirmed freshness, and visual inspection cannot establish this result. Files remain unchanged.
